assertions.quoted_span: The temporary designation provided for in paragraph 1 shall not exceed a period of one year. It may be renewed once for a further period of one year.
assertions.claim: The current one-year temporary official-laboratory designation and one-time renewal limits are absent from the Stage B population and ledger even though the Puglian competent authority makes the designation decision, so the decision-reachability test fails.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Add the producer to seam 1 and mint independently computable limits for the initial designation and permitted renewal without inventing any additional conditions.
assertions.falsifier: A binding allocation in the attached Stage A corpus shows that a different authority, rather than the Regional Plant Health Service acting as competent authority, makes temporary official-laboratory designations in Puglia, or existing Stage B rows under another identifier already encode both one-year limits.

assertions.quoted_span: The competent authorities shall organise audits of the official laboratories they have designated in accordance with Article 37(1) on a regular basis and any time they consider that an audit is necessary, unless they find such audits to be redundant considering the accreditation assessment referred to in point (e) of Article 37(4).
assertions.claim: The current regular-audit requirement is absent from the Stage B population and ledger even though it governs the Osservatorio's oversight of laboratories it designates and is resolvable from its own audit and accreditation records.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Add the producer to seam 1 and mint an open-term recurrence for audits on a regular basis, preserving the accreditation-assessment exception without fabricating a calendar cadence.
assertions.falsifier: A binding allocation shows that the Osservatorio does not act as the competent authority for audits of the official laboratories it designates, or an existing Stage B clock under another producer already carries this regular-audit requirement and exception.

assertions.quoted_span: The competent authorities shall immediately withdraw the designation of an official laboratory, either completely or for certain tasks, where it fails to take appropriate and timely remedial action following the results of an audit provided for in paragraph 1
assertions.claim: The immediate-withdrawal requirement is absent from the Stage B population and ledger even though withdrawal of the Osservatorio's own laboratory designation is a vested decision triggered by holdable audit and remedial-action records.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Add a separate promptness-standard clock anchored on recorded failure to take the required remedial action after the qualifying audit, preserving complete versus task-specific withdrawal.
assertions.falsifier: A binding allocation shows that another authority withdraws the relevant Puglian official-laboratory designation, the audit and remedial-action facts cannot be held by the Osservatorio, or an existing Stage B clock under another identifier already represents this immediate withdrawal.

assertions.quoted_span: the survey design and sampling scheme shall be able to identify with at least 90 % confidence a level of presence of infected plants of 0,5 %.
assertions.claim: The expression-grain ledger contains not_a_clock dispositions with why set to null for this operative numeric expression, so the recorded exclusion supplies none of the three permitted grounds and does not reference the parameter that actually carries the requirement.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Deduplicate overlapping expression windows and make every surviving disposition either reference the owning clock or parameter or state an explicit permitted exclusion ground.
assertions.falsifier: The disposition convention expressly defines null-why not_a_clock entries as non-semantic duplicate windows and another disposition for the same exact expression references B-PAR-EU-10-sub1-C90-p0.5.

checked_sound: Exhaustive review of the 144 distinct dispositions[].why values found no non-null exclusion resting on absence of a held case, act, precedent, or past exercise.

All eight dispositions relying on a closed producer interval concern pre-L.R. 45 versions marked SUPERSEDED with effective_to_exclusive 2021-12-18; their reasons preserve the directly applicable Union rule for retrospective judgment rather than relying on absence of a held case.
The uncovered-set review separated seam-4 notice, election, execution, and enforcement clocks from seams 1–3 and did not report their deliberate absence.

The uncovered-set review confirmed that the six-month national-reference-laboratory cessation notice in IT-DM-169819-2022:Art.7(11) and the five-year EU-reference-laboratory term in EU-2017-625:Art.93(1) are vested in other actors, unlike the regional competent-authority decisions in Articles 39 and 42.

The present-row sample covered every clock kind in every seam: seam 1 recurrence, promptness_standard, deadline, and same_calendar_day; seam 2 promptness_standard, recurrence, deadline, minimum_duration, eligibility_threshold, and ordering_constraint; seam 3 promptness_standard, lookback_window, recurrence, ordering_constraint, not_before, and deadline.

Pre-M5 and post-M5 Article 5(1)(c) first-year survey clocks remain separate and carry their respective effective intervals; the post-M5 row also carries the 90 percent confidence and 1 percent design-prevalence target.

Containment and eradication are both represented: Article 4 carries distinct 2.5 km eradication and 5 km containment buffer floors, Article 15 carries the 5 km to 2 km containment-band versions, and the regional 48-hour treatment-to-removal sequence has separate eradication and containment clocks for DDS 31 and DDS 45.
The Article 15(3) island exemption is present as a greater-than-5-km threshold and therefore does not depend on a historically held island case.
The PNI 2026 per-stratum design values are present as design_target parameters, while no RiPEST model internals were admitted.

No sampled present clock or parameter depended on fabricated evidence: legal-state anchors use Stage A effects, event anchors identify OPERATOR_RECORD or RECEIVED_RECORD, and geographic parameters use public-law geometry.
unresolved: Article 39 states that audits occur "on a regular basis" but supplies no calendar cadence; the corpus supports an open-term recurrence only.
